description: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer: a 3D game where kids complete missions inspired by real astronaut training: launch checklists, spacewalk repairs, station resource management and emergencies. Seymur (Unity, C#, Blender, Photoshop) builds the 3D world. Ali (Python, Java, security) handles backend and keeps it safe for kids. Huseyn (Python, art design) leads UI and visuals. We love space, games, AI and cybersecurity, and want to make STEM learning feel like a real mission.
